the development of an ELISA for protein-acetaldehyde (A) adducts (P-AAs) in human sera.
the use of enzyme linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA's) for the determination of protein-acetaldehye adducts in human serum.
the detection and identification of protein-acetaldehydes adducts (PAA) in serum of alcoholic subjects.
